d:
Luka Doncic put on a SHOW for the ages at EuroBasket 2022!
Facing a stacked French team featuring Rudy Gobert and Evan Fournier, Luka went absolutely OFF, scoring 47 POINTS in one of the most incredible individual performances in EuroBasket history!
He added 7 rebounds and 5 assists, shooting 15-of-23 from the field to lead Slovenia to an impressive 88-82 victory over France.
With this historic performance, Luka recorded the second-highest scoring total in EuroBasket history and helped Slovenia secure first place in Group B!
When Luka gets going, there is simply NO stopping him!
